

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 132 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 132 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 134 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 134 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 135 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 135 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 135.000001 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 67.5000005 0, 135.000001 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 136 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 68 0, 136 0)"

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 138 0)')
=> "LINESTRING(0 0, 69 0, 138 0)"
